title: Blue Moon in Surreal Desert
description: A large, smiling blue moon with yellow crescent eyes dominates the center of a vibrant surreal desert scene. In the foreground, a robed figure holds a white card while surrounded by floating blue orbs containing faces, potted alien plants, ancient adobe buildings, and a colorful abstract profile silhouette to the right.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape with a giant smiling deep blue moon featuring glowing yellow crescent eyes as the central focus. A robed alchemist-like figure stands in the foreground holding a card. The scene is filled with floating blue spheres containing faces, colorful potted alien plants, adobe buildings, swirling patterns, and a large colorful profile silhouette on the right side under a warm sunset sky.
